profile_name: Plans on — the plan-following arm for PM-10
description: Sets PLANS_ENABLED to 1, which is already the shipped default. It exists so the PM-10 paired A/B is symmetric: both arms load a profile containing exactly one parameter and differ only in its value, rather than one arm loading a profile and the other running bare. A profile that only restates a default cannot itself move the result — the a5_null_defaults arm in this directory is the same idea used as a harness self-check.
